public_rationale: The share numbers back the core claim. Similarweb shows ChatGPT's web-traffic share fell from 87.2% to 68% during 2025, to about 64–65% in January 2026, and to 52.7% by May 2026. Gemini and Claude gained over the same period. Sensor Tower put ChatGPT at 46.4% in May 2026, its first time below half. This erosion came as rivals shipped similar chatbots, which matches the speaker's account. Two caveats. No data were found for most of 2024, and ChatGPT's share was still about 87% at the end of 2024, so 'ever since January 2024' is not fully shown. The cause is also partly Google's distribution advantage.
limitations: 2024 share data are missing, so the decline is documented only from late 2024.
